name: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

angles.text: As the Horde settles in Durotar, supplies from the wilderness help fortify and grow Orgrimmar.
As an orc, you know that Durotar's elements call for rugged materials gathered by hunters and laborers.

aliases: what are thunder ridge hides used for
faq.answer: Thunder Ridge lizard hides are too thick and coarse for wearable armor, but their toughness suits them for building. Orgrimmar's peons line new walls and roofs with the hides to guard against the elements.
faq.q: Why does Orgrimmar need lizard hides from Thunder Ridge?

aliases: who gives beasts of thunder ridge
faq.answer: Kamari is a leatherworker in Orgrimmar who supplies sturdy pelts and hides to the city's builders and peons. The hides are needed for ongoing construction.
Thunder Ridge is a rugged canyon in Durotar, where lizards have thick hides Kamari wants for Orgrimmar's new buildings.

aliases: what are the cured hides for
faq.answer: Kamari requests cured light hides alongside the heavy lizard hides to complement those materials. The request also tests your broader familiarity and skill with leather processing.
faq.q: Why are cured light hides requested along with lizard hides?

faq.answer: Orgrimmar is the newly established Horde capital, and its ongoing construction must house growing numbers of orcs and their allies. That growth creates a constant need for raw materials.
faq.q: Why is Orgrimmar expanding so rapidly?

faq.answer: Thunder Ridge lizard hides are generally too thick and rigid for flexible armor. Their chief practical use is in construction.
faq.q: Can the lizard hides from Thunder Ridge be made into armor?

sections.body: Orgrimmar keeps growing as the Horde makes a home in Durotar. New homes, workshops, and defenses need lumber, stone, and animal skins. Timber comes from farther away, but Durotar's beasts provide sturdy hides for the peons and builders.
sections.title: A Growing Capital

sections.body: The lizards of Thunder Ridge have tough hides, too thick and stiff for wearable armor. Properly harvested, their pelts line the walls and ceilings of Orgrimmar's timber and stone buildings. There, they shield the interiors from the harsh sun and sudden canyon winds.
sections.title: Beasts of the Canyon

summary: Across Durotar, Orgrimmar's builders need hides to keep the growing capital strong. Kamari sends you to Thunder Ridge for lizard hides and cured light hides.
attribution: In-game quest text: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
